name: Annapurna Ghar Ka Khana
tagline: Fresh home-style veg tiffin in HSR Layout and Koramangala
about: We are two sisters cooking fresh Maharashtrian and North Indian veg food every morning for students and office people. Our food is made with less oil and less spice, and we can do a no onion-garlic option on request. We deliver in a steel tiffin and collect the empty one the next day. You can pause your monthly plan for travel with 1 day notice.
hours: Monday to Saturday. Lunch delivered between 12:30 and 1:30 pm, dinner between 7:30 and 8:30 pm. Sunday off.
